newsitem.title: BULGARIA: Bulgaria c.bank cuts annual main interest rate.
newsitem.headline: Bulgaria c.bank cuts annual main interest rate.

text.p: The Bulgarian National Bank (BNB) cut the simple main annual interest rate to 9.56 percent from 10.12 percent, effective from July 7, dealers said.
The BNB confirmed the rate cut in a statement. "The BNB sets the main simple annual rate at 9.56 percent as of July 7," it said.
The statement did not say how the new main interest rate was calculated. BNB officials were not immediately available for comment.

A week ago the BNB set the simple main rate at 10.12 percent, shadowing an excessive lev liqidity on the domestic money market. The rate was then calculated on the average yield to maturity on three-month discount T-bills.

Interest rates have come down to 0.79 percent monthly from 18 percent in March, reflecting a stabilisation trend of the economy following an IMF reform and funding deal reached in March. On Tuesday Bulgaria entered a restrictive fixed exchange rate regime aimed at restoring confidence in the financial system.
